mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for an AI SEO implementation for a CPA firm?

acceptedAnswer.text: The implementation process typically begins with a comprehensive audit of your current online presence and SEO performance. This is followed by AI-driven keyword research to identify high-value terms relevant to accounting services. Next, AI tools assist in content strategy and optimization, including recommendations for new content creation and existing content refinement. Technical SEO elements are then optimized for site speed, mobile-friendliness, and crawlability. Ongoing monitoring and analysis using AI allow for continuous adjustments and improvements to strategy, ensuring your firm maintains strong search visibility and adapts to algorithm changes.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an audit, AI-driven keyword research, content optimization, technical SEO improvements, and continuous monitoring to maintain strong search visibility.
